Name: Victy's Twink Elliott - Winter
Author: fafaferraro
Description:
[b]I did get permission from Victy's on NAVER to upload this work in here. 
[/b]
This mod contains 6 PNG pictures of Elliott from Victy's 1.5. I just messed around on photoshop to give him a scarf for winter.
The user PhysicalExorcism did a [url=https://cafe.naver.com/starvall/364284]blonde version[/url]﻿, which I also uploaded.

To install it, I recommend downloading [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16238]Victy's Portrait Mod[/url].
You just need to replace the PNG images to make it work. 

I am aware there is a slight (very slight) color variation between the portraits. 
I tried everything to tweak them to look minimally close, but it didn't work.
I just pretend it is the different sun from winter/summer which affects his hair and skin.
If someone knows how to fix it, I would be grateful.
